No
348
26/5/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
May 25th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that in consequence of the assassination of Chen Chi Mei 陳其美 the rebels have decided to kill all Government agents who are seen in the western part of the French Concession and the Authorities of that Settlement will, it is hoped, close their eyes to such crimes.
It is reported that General Yang received a telegram yesterday from Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang instructing him to take no orders direct from Peking in future. General Yang has informed Peking of the Chiangchun's instructions and has asked for orders as to how he should act.
It is reported that Chiangchun Feng Kuo Chang will start a newspaper in Shanghai to promote his policy. This journal will be called Sing Tsoong Nya Pao 新中外報 and is expected to appear soon.
General Feng Kuo Chang has sent a telegram to the Director of the Arsenal instructing him to make as much ammunition and as many rifles as possible but not to send any to other provinces.
It is reported that the Government troops will soon attack Chekiang.

Your Obedient Servant,
[签名]
Chief Detective Inspector.

[批：P.S.]
[批：K...?]
[签名]
Captain Superintendent of Police.

编号
348
1916年5月26日
上海工部局。
（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）
1916年5月25日。

先生：
据报，鉴于陈其美遇刺身亡，反叛分子已决定杀害所有在法租界西部出现的政府特工，并希望该租界当局对此类罪行睁一只眼闭一只眼。
据报，杨将军昨日收到张勋（Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang）发来的电报，指示他今后不得直接接受来自北京的命令。杨将军已将张勋的指示通报北京，并请示应如何行动。
据报，张勋（Chiangchun Feng Kuo Chang）将在上海创办一份报纸以宣扬其政策。该报拟命名为《新中外报》，预计不久即将刊行。
冯国璋将军已向兵工厂总监发出电报，指示其尽可能多地制造弹药和步枪，但不得向其他省份运送任何军火。
据报，政府军队即将进攻浙江。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
总探长。

[批注：附言]
[批注：K...?]
[签名]
警务处总监
